description: Schedule a maintenance window on the status page: planned work on some components between two times. While it runs those components read "Under maintenance" unless an incident is open on them; it never colours a day. At most 7 days long and 365 days ahead. Owners and Admins only. Titles and messages are what customers read: no internal names, repositories, people or other customers. Text the disclosure check stops is refused with disclosure_hits_remaining and the hits; reword it. Acts as you, with the same checks as the Console; a service account's key is refused. Requires `write` scope.

accountIds.description: Customer account ids; required with audience accounts.

audience.description: public: the public page and every customer link. accounts: only the links of accountIds.

endsAt.description: When it ends; not in the past. Epoch milliseconds or an ISO 8601 string with a time zone (2026-11-20T02:00:00Z).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

message.description: What customers read: what changes and what they may notice.

startsAt.description: When the work begins. Epoch milliseconds or an ISO 8601 string with a time zone (2026-11-20T02:00:00Z).

title.description: One line customers read (at most 120 characters). Not the internal title or cause.

name: anyforge_schedule_status_page_maintenance
title: Schedule status page maintenance
